verdict.rationale: HubSpot's knowledge base documents that you can create workflows to automate processes, so the core capability exists. The pack only contains that thin one-line mention: nothing describes trigger types or the specific actions in the story. Webhooks (for third-party integrators) and AI-driven CRM updates are adjacent, but they are not ops-built workflow actions. Missing for 10: documented enrollment triggers, update-record actions, create-task actions, internal notification actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
